ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A hemispheric hole is carved into each face of a wooden cube with sides of length 2. All holes are equally sized, and their midpoints are in the centre of the faces of the cube. The holes are as big as possible so that each hemisphere touches each adjacent hemisphere in exactly one point. How big is the diameter of the holes?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a cube; at the centers of several visible faces there are circular or elliptical gray regions, indicating that at the center of each face a hemispherical hole of the same size has been dug. Reasoning: According to the specified method, place the cube with side length 2 in the coordinate system and center it at the origin, then the faces are located at x=±1, y=±1, z=±1. The centers of two adjacent faces can be taken as (1,0,0) and (0,1,0). Each hemispherical hole can be regarded as half of a sphere whose center is the center of the face where it is located, and the radius of the hole is equal to the radius of that sphere. To make adjacent hemispherical holes as large as possible and just touch at one point, the corresponding two equal-radius spheres should be externally tangent, so the distance between the two sphere centers equals 2r, which is the diameter of the hole. Calculate the distance between the centers of adjacent faces: sqrt((1-0)^2+(0-1)^2+(0-0)^2)=sqrt(2). Therefore the diameter of the hole is sqrt(2).

method.method_draft: Model the cube in coordinates with side length 2, centered at the origin, so adjacent face centers can be taken as (1,0,0) and (0,1,0). Each hemispheric hole is part of a sphere whose center is the midpoint of its cube face. For two holes on adjacent faces to be as large as possible while touching in exactly one point, the corresponding equal spheres must be externally tangent, so the distance between their centers equals twice the radius, i.e. the diameter. Compute the distance between adjacent face centers: sqrt((1-0)^2+(0-1)^2)=sqrt(2). Therefore the hole diameter is sqrt(2).

推理：按指定方法，把边长为 2 的立方体放在坐标系中并以原点为中心，则各面位于 x=±1, y=±1, z=±1。相邻两个面的中心可以取为 (1,0,0) 和 (0,1,0)。每个半球形孔可看作以所在面中心为球心的一个球的一半，孔的半径等于该球的半径。要使相邻半球孔尽可能大且恰好在一点相触，对应的两个等半径球应外切，所以两球心距离等于 2r，也就是孔的直径。计算相邻面中心距离：sqrt((1-0)^2+(0-1)^2+(0-0)^2)=sqrt(2)。因此孔的直径为 sqrt(2)。
